**Fix #263 items 1-3 (Tier B): product-keyed broker positions, NRML-only entries at the sink, freeze-load conflict raises.**

Addresses items 1-3 of #263. Item 4 (plan version on the basket tag) stays open until the plan builder lands.

- **Item 1** `backend/ofo/execution/partial.py`: the broker read is keyed by (contract, product). An exit uses only the row in the ledger's product. If a contract is also held in another product, a separate template names that position, and the platform never trades it. A flat or other-product-only row is refused, so the check fails closed.
- **Item 2** `backend/ofo/execution/send_guard.py`: the sink refuses a non-NRML entry or adjustment order (ADR-080 "every entry and adjustment order is NRML"). This is a structural guarantee, run-discipline B8.
- **Item 3** `backend/ofo_app/freeze_store.py`: insert first. On a conflict the stored limit is compared, and a different limit raises instead of being dropped. `tests_app/test_freeze_store_race.py` covers it.
- New error templates in the partial-exit 301-310 range (templates + pins).
